steps._note: PREAMBLE ADDED 20261022: the owned human is now created by the scripted hire preamble (recipe F1 in SCENARIO_MANIFEST_20261022.md, section Fixtures); the "pre-hired NPC" precondition below is satisfied by it, the remaining preconditions (station, crops, containers, assignment) are still manual. CLASS: FIXTURE-DEPENDENT (owned human, powered/fueled campfire, Craft job assigned: GAP-2). Assertions: STATE = expectUi Done/Not eligible text, state captures (inventory/rebirth), expectNoUi recipe-queue:, expectNoErrors; LOG-ONLY = expectLog pickup-credited and Craft practice award (the owner XP is state-asserted in claude_npc_b13_awards.json). IDS VERIFIED 20261022: foodRawMeat, resourceWood exist (vanilla items.xml). Requirement B05 stage -> queue -> cook -> pickup -> deposit. PRECONDITIONS: owned human, powered/fueled campfire placed in range, Craft job assigned (GAP-2). Single-ingredient part expects journal phases output-attributed, pickup-attempted, pickup-credited, completed. Multi-ingredient part (part 2) expects REFUSAL while RebirthNpcRecipeIngredientSet.Qualified=false: recipe-queue:<id>+<id> refused by TryParseKey. Do not flip the const for the main run. Owner XP receipt is asserted in claude_npc_b13_awards.json. SELECTOR REVIEW 20261022 (Codex batch 6): 1 click/expect selectors now carry an explicit window so an id or text cannot match a same-named node in another open group (e.g. HUD, backpack, vehicle windows). Item selectors (item=) are intentionally left window-less because player backpack cells and NPC cells live in different groups; resolve them from the saved uitree on the first run.

OWNED-HUMAN PREAMBLE (manifest section Fixtures, recipe F1; real game interaction, no admin bypass): spawn an unowned survivor, open the real activation radial and Talk (activateNearestEntity default command talk), pay the real Hire price with casinoCoin. Price source: Scripts/NPC/Interaction/RebirthSurvivorHirePayment.cs Price(): HireCost 500 (Config/_NPC/entityclasses.xml) + 500 x $FR_NPC_Level, discounted by perkBetterBarter / trade aura; so 3000 coins cover any fresh survivor. The hired entity class is npcRebirthPersistentSurvivorManSDCS (RebirthHiredEntityClass).
If btnHumanHire is disabled read humanHireFeedback and humanHireSlots in the saved uitree (hire capacity / level rule, B01); do not continue the scenario without an owned human.

OWNERSHIP PROOF: coins were spent (>= the 500 base cost) and the Companions window lists the human. Entity id, class and stable id for rbnpcadmin inspect are in the npcgear reply saved below (the runner cannot pass a captured id into a later step: read it from out/tests and use it by hand).

OPTIONAL fixture parts, all through the real UI: (a) station: {"setblock": {"name": "campfire","x": 16,"y": 45,"z": 993 } } plus resourceWood given and placed in it by hand (cooking scenarios use workstation_campfire fixtures); (b) NPC bag contents: Companions window, Equipment/Inventory tab, shift-click an item as in claude_ui_companion_equipment_inventory.json; (c) Desk assignment: Companions window, Assignments tab, click asgAdd. The Add dialog is code-spawned (GAP-2), so choosing job/target stays manual. These optional parts are NOT scripted here.
PART 1 single ingredient: owner assigns cook of 1 recipe via Desk (manual, GAP-2); then wait for the NPC to walk, stage, queue, cook, pick up.

Custody: raw meat count in the owner state capture must have dropped by the recipe amount (or moved to the station); a cooked output must appear in the owner bag or the NPC bag, never both and never lost. Compare captures.
PART 2 multi-ingredient: stage a 2-ingredient recipe; expect the exact RefusalReason text after prefix xuiRebirthDeskCraftNotEligible (BC-41 item 4).
